avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces CYP3A4 and MAO-A, reducing rizatriptan levels and efficacy; may increase serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; discontinue St. John's Wort at least 2 weeks before rizatriptan therapy

avoid_supplements.name: 5-Hydroxytryptophan (5-HTP)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Direct serotonin precursor increases central serotonergic activity, elevating serotonin syndrome risk with triptan use
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use concurrently with rizatriptan

avoid_supplements.name: L-Tryptophan (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Serotonin precursor may potentiate serotonergic effects and increase serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose supplementation; use only dietary amounts if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Linezolid
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Weak MAOI activity combined with triptan's serotonergic effects significantly increases serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Absolute contraindication; do not use with rizatriptan

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild stimulant properties may theoretically potentiate cardiovascular effects of triptan; limited clinical evidence
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased heart rate or blood pressure; use with caution in patients with cardiac risk factors

caution_supplements.name: Feverfew
caution_supplements.mechanism: Used for migraine prevention; additive vasoconstrictive effects possible with rizatriptan
caution_supplements.action: Generally acceptable for migraine prophylaxis; monitor for vasoconstrictive symptoms

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance migraine relief and reduce triptan need; no direct interaction mechanism
caution_supplements.action: Can be used concurrently for migraine prophylaxis; consider as adjunctive therapy

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Delays rizatriptan absorption and peak plasma concentration, reducing efficacy for acute migraine treatment
avoid_foods.action: Take rizatriptan on empty stomach or with light meal; avoid within 2 hours of high-fat food consumption

caution_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, soy sauce, fermented products)
caution_foods.mechanism: Rizatriptan is not an MAOI, but excessive tyramine intake may theoretically potentiate vasoconstrictive effects
caution_foods.action: No strict restriction required; normal dietary tyramine intake acceptable; counsel patients on moderation

caution_foods.name: Caffeine
caution_foods.mechanism: May enhance triptan efficacy and migraine relief; some formulations contain caffeine; potential for mild additive stimulation
caution_foods.action: Moderate caffeine intake acceptable; excessive use may worsen rebound headaches

monitoring_notes: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate, muscle rigidity) if used with other serotonergic agents. Assess cardiovascular status, particularly in patients with hypertension or coronary artery disease, as triptans cause vasoconstriction.
